# Radoslav Radev Says Training Planche Twice A Day Is An Option

Radoslav Radev says that for people who can, training twice a day is possible, for two hours per day or one hour and a half per day. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 01:13]

## Details

- With a morning and an evening workout of one hour each, it takes two hours per day. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:41]
- He says you can train two times, for two hours per day or one hour and a half per day. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 01:13]
- He says that if you do it on two of the four days per week that you train, it's definitely enough. [src: vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 01:55]

## Evidence

- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 00:41 (Radoslav Radev): "if you train in the morning and evening one hour each workout so two workouts one hour it will take you two hours per day"
- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 01:13 (Radoslav Radev): "for two hours per day or one hour and a half per day you can train two times and the first workout"
- vid-Y15L_gceOow @ 01:55 (Radoslav Radev): "this opportunity from four days per week that you train if you do it two of them definitely it's enough"

## Connected Ideas

- [[Radoslav Radev Advises Four Planche Workouts Per Week For Six Weeks]] — the base weekly frequency.
